name: hud_ui_polyline_constructor
description: HudUiPolyline::Constructor initializes a polyline element, clears points, invalidates, and clears the clip rect.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4bf840 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x4bf840 validates HudUiElement::Constructor(self, 0, 0), polyline ftable assignment, pointCount zeroing, clearing 0xa8 bytes of points, HudUiElement::Invalidate, and clipRect clearing.
The native smoke seeds stale polyline state and verifies ftable, invalidate flag, zero point count, null clip rect, and cleared points after construction.
